title: Sickle cell variants, hemolytic and aplastic anemia, hemophilia, neutropenia
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's blood disorder (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for cyclic neutropenia.

HPI
Pt is a 61 y.o. male presenting for routine hematology f/u. Pt has a hx of cyclic neutropenia characterized by recurring low neutrophil counts every few weeks. He reports stable symptoms and reports compliance with his current G-CSF regimen. No new concerns voiced today.

Medication List
G-CSF (filgrastim) injections as scheduled.

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
CV: RRR, CTAB.
Resp: Clear to auscultation.
Skin: No rashes or petechiae noted.
Neuro: Alert and oriented x3.

Assessment
1. Cyclic neutropenia. Pt remains stable on current G-CSF protocol with managed neutrophil fluctuations.

Plan
1. Continue G-CSF injections.
2. Monitor CBC and ANC counts q4 weeks.
3. Pt to call if any acute symptoms develop.
4. F/u in 3 months.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, DO, 10/14/2026
